conclusion: AppleARMIODevice objects ARE allocated (103 allocator dispatches) but AppleARMIO::start (0xfffffff00aad7da0, fixup-proven slot +0x360 for both AppleARMIO and AppleARMIODevice vtables) is NEVER invoked, and the +0x450 match-dispatch callback (0xfffffff00aad7f70) never fires. The walk pass shows 61/102 objects freed or reused (no valid vtable) — consistent with init() failing and the object being released before registration. The blocker is therefore: AppleARMIODevice nubs are constructed but never successfully initialized/registered, so no personality (including AppleASCWrapV6) can match them.
